decisions.reason: A perfect binder sits squarely within the firm's long-standing binding and finishing expertise, so its technicians and demonstration capabilities let it interpret customer feedback and service the machine, making retention likely despite sparse web evidence.
The fully automatic perfect binder builds on existing binding knowledge and fits the firm's stated direction toward integrated automation, so the firm can absorb and apply learning from it.
An inline/nearline booklet maker extends the firm's core bookletmaking portfolio and matches its strategic focus on digital print finishing, giving strong related knowledge to support and improve it.
